name: Doorstep Air
description: Ten ideas for a two-minute step outside, or to the nearest open window.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Ten ideas for a very short trip to a door or window, one at a time, shown on Away Prompts.
help.goal: There is nothing to finish. Even one idea counts as a break.
howToPlay: Stand up and head for a door or window.
Read the idea and try it for as long as you like.
Press Another idea for a different one, or Back at desk when you return.
tips: Ideas are only suggestions. If you cannot go outside, an open window or a far corner of the room works too.
